race.comment: HIGH FALLS (7) looked smart winning on debut at Hamilton when hard in the market, coming from off the pace to win well. Should only improve to 1400m now and looks hard to beat again, especially with the main danger coming out. PRESTIGE ZERPRISE (2) has won two on the bounce, too strong at Morphettville latest. Should be right there again and hard to hold out. ATAEGINA (10) is racing well without winning, placing in her past two. Turns around quickly here and the run two back reads well. RAVEN'S SILVER (8) got home well here last time for second and up to 1400m may suit a bit better now, each way chance.
